item.title: 🔵 Crims compromised energy firms' Microsoft accounts, sent 600 phishing emails
item.description:
Why this matters: Increased credential/phishing risk for users; reinforce MFA and user awareness.

item.title: 🔴 Europe's GDPR cops dished out €1.2B in fines last year as data breaches piled up
